propositions: test_full_backend_account_is_present fails deterministically on hosts with scc or lizard installed because it asserts a metric backend record without controlling metric-tool availability
the 50-LOC fixture is below the 800-LOC metric threshold, so _metric_invoke returns no match and emits no metric coverage record when the tool is present
the sibling test_metric_backend_skip_is_reconstructable already controls _METRIC_CANDIDATES to force missing-tool absence, but test_full_backend_account_is_present lacks this fixture control
the fix adds explicit missing-metric-tool fixture control to test_full_backend_account_is_present to make it deterministic and measure skipped coverage with reason no_tool
production grounding behavior and evidence schema remain unchanged; a successful tool run with no threshold match must not fabricate a match record
